text:
Estimated items from the first photo, with amounts eaten judged from the second photo:

- Sushi: 3 thick rolls (futomaki-style with salmon and avocado), about 35 g each, so about 105–120 g. At roughly 150 kcal per 100 g, that is about 170 kcal.
- Soup: a bowl of about 250 g of creamy corn or egg soup, roughly 50 kcal per 100 g, so about 100 kcal. The bowl is almost empty afterward, so nearly all of it was eaten.
- Juice: about 250 g at 45 kcal per 100 g, so about 110 kcal. The glass is empty afterward.
- Pickled ginger: about 15 g, roughly 10 kcal. The cup is mostly empty.
- Wasabi: about 5 g, roughly 5 kcal.
- Soy sauce: about 15 g, roughly 10 kcal. Some is left on the plate, so about 10 g was eaten, roughly 6 kcal.

The sushi and soup are fully eaten, so most of the food was consumed. Food and drink together come to roughly 170 + 100 + 110 + 10 + 5 + 6 ≈ 400 kcal.

Mass: sushi 110 g + soup 250 g + juice 250 g + ginger 15 g + wasabi 5 g + soy sauce 10 g ≈ 640 g.
